ui.filtrer_par_bloc_constructeur_ou: Filter by block, manufacturer or software
ui.glisser_pour_choisir_la_plage: Drag to choose the A–B range. Wheel: zoom. Right-drag: pan. Double-click or Home key: full view.

ui.indiquez_le_repere_de_la: Give the loop tag, the controlled quantity, the usual operating point with its unit and the result sought.
ui.je_declare_verifier_ou_approuver: I declare that I verify or approve my own calculation (self-review, recorded as such)
ui.journal_en_ajout_seul_chaine: Append-only log, chained by SHA-256 fingerprints: an entry changed or removed in the middle breaks the chain. It does not protect against a complete rewrite by someone who can write anything in the project file: note the head fingerprint elsewhere to detect it.
ui.laboratoire_hors_ligne_sans_sauvegard: Offline laboratory without saving or manufacturer mapping
ui.le_mode_se_lit_avec: The mode is read together with the setpoint, the measurement and the control output: place it, if possible, at an address consecutive to the other three for a single request per sample. ORIAS assumes no convention: give the raw value that your program uses for “manual”. A Boolean mode must be copied into a word (INT/UINT). Samples taken outside manual are counted and reported: an open-loop test is not valid there.
ui.lecture_seule_orias_nemet_que: Read-only: ORIAS only sends read requests (Modbus 03/04, S7 “read var”). No write, no forcing, no command. Use an authorised test bench only.
ui.les_colonnes_numeriques_du_fichier: The numeric columns of the file appear here once the data are open.
ui.les_deux_essais_ont_ete: Both tests were carried out in open loop, without known saturation, with the same units and under comparable conditions.
ui.les_reponses_simulees_des_reglages: The simulated responses of the tunings will appear here after the calculation.
ui.lire_aussi_le_mode_du_2: Also read the controller mode (manual / automatic)
ui.mesure_observee_et_modele_sortie: Observed measurement and model, control output, over time
ui.mise_a_lechelle_lineaire_physique: Linear scaling: physical = low + (raw − raw low) × (physical high − physical low) / (raw high − raw low). Leave 0 / 1 / 0 / 1 for a REAL value already in physical units.
ui.molette_pour_zoomer_clic_droit: Wheel to zoom, right-drag to pan, hover to read the values; clicking a curve in the legend hides it. The calculated control (CV) is the one requested before limiting; the applied control output (MV) is the one acting in the model. Zooming alters neither the simulation nor its export.
ui.molette_zoom_clic_droit_glisse: Wheel: zoom. Right-drag: pan. Double-click or Home key: full view. Arrows: pan.
ui.molette_zoom_clic_droit_glisse_2: Wheel: zoom. Right-drag: pan. Double-click or Home key: full view.

ui.p_et_i_sur_lecart: P and I on the error (setpoint − measurement) · D on the measurement only · implicit Euler discrete filter · conditional integration.

ui.pi_par_la_regle_simc: PI by the SIMC rule for integrating processes, nominal loop margins and PIDFF block values (not qualified).
ui.pour_cent_de_sortie_par: Percent of output per MV unit
ui.pour_un_historique_long_repere: For a long history: finds the clean control output steps and proposes two independent ranges
ui.prerequis_cpu_acces_put_get: CPU prerequisites: PUT/GET access allowed and DB with non-optimised access (absolute addresses). A PID_Compact instance DB is optimised: copy the setpoint, the measurement and the control output into a dedicated DB. S7 values are transmitted as ABCD.
ui.prototype_non_qualifie_industrielleme: Prototype not industrially qualified · No parameter sent to a PLC · Calculations not saved
ui.rechercher_les_essais_exploitables_da: _Search for usable tests in this recording…
ui.reglage_et_actions_sur_le: Tuning and actions on the accepted model
ui.regle_des_quatre_yeux_celui: Four-eyes rule: whoever calculated a step neither verifies nor approves it, except a declared self-review, recorded as such. The author of each decision is the identity of the Windows session (account, SID, workstation): it is not typed.
ui.regle_simc_des_procedes_integrateurs: SIMC rule for integrating processes (Skogestad, 2003): Kc = 1 / (k′ (τc + θ)), Ti = 4 (τc + θ). Theoretical values from the validated model; the margins are those of the nominal loop only. No value is qualified on an installation.

ui.valeurs_documentaires_non_qualifiees_: Documentary values, not qualified. They come from the manufacturer's official documentation and have not been tried on a PLC: read them again and enter them by hand, never by automatic copy.
Documentary values, not qualified, for a PI controller. No installation value is assumed: fill in every field. Read them again and enter them by hand, never by automatic copy.

ui.vous_choisissez_un_objectif_de: You choose a robustness objective, not a response time. ORIAS looks for the fastest tuning that stays robust on the identified model and on the uncertainty of its parameters (SIMC rules, Skogestad 2003; maximum sensitivity Ms, Åström and Hägglund 2006). If the data cannot guarantee one, ORIAS refuses and says what to do. Theoretical result, never qualified on an installation.
